CREATE TABLE "hotel"."amenity" (
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "hotelId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "icon" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "hotel"."booking" (
  "adults" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "bookingNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "cancellationFee" numeric(10,2),
  "cancellationPolicySnapshot" json,
  "cancelledAt" timestamptz,
  "checkIn" date NOT NULL,
  "checkOut" date NOT NULL,
  "children" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'EUR' NOT NULL,
  "depositDue" numeric(10,2),
  "depositPaidAt" timestamptz,
  "externalBookingId" text,
  "externalChannel" text,
  "extrasTotal" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "guestId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "guestMessage" text,
  "hotelId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "internalNote" text,
  "roomsTotal" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "source" text DEFAULT 'WEBSITE' NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'INQUIRY' NOT NULL,
  "totalAmount" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "booking_dates_ordered_895ca4da" CHECK ("checkOut" > "checkIn"),
  CONSTRAINT "booking_source_check_0cd4d5fd" CHECK ("source" IN ('WEBSITE', 'PHONE', 'EMAIL', 'WALK_IN', 'MANUAL', 'BOOKING_COM', 'EXPEDIA', 'AIRBNB', 'OTHER')),
  CONSTRAINT "booking_status_check_8281edf7" CHECK ("status" IN ('INQUIRY', 'PENDING', 'CONFIRMED', 'CHECKED_IN', 'CHECKED_OUT', 'CANCELLED', 'NO_SHOW'))
)

CREATE TABLE "hotel"."bookingExtra" (
  "bookingId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "bookingRoomId" int4,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "serviceItemId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "totalAmount" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "unitPrice" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "unitSnapshot" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "bookingExtra_quantity_positive_4c388344" CHECK ("quantity" >= 1),
  CONSTRAINT "bookingExtra_unitSnapshot_check_0f625b6f" CHECK ("unitSnapshot" IN ('PER_STAY', 'PER_NIGHT', 'PER_DAY', 'PER_PERSON', 'PER_PERSON_NIGHT'))
)

CREATE TABLE "hotel"."bookingRoom" (
  "adults" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "bookingId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "checkIn" date NOT NULL,
  "checkOut" date NOT NULL,
  "children" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "guestName" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "note" text,
  "pricingModeSnapshot" text NOT NULL,
  "ratePlanId" int4,
  "roomId" int4,
  "roomTypeId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "totalAmount" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "bookingRoom_dates_ordered_895ca4da" CHECK ("checkOut" > "checkIn"),
  CONSTRAINT "bookingRoom_pricingModeSnapshot_check_114bbb7c" CHECK ("pricingModeSnapshot" IN ('PER_ROOM', 'PER_PERSON'))
)

CREATE TABLE "hotel"."bookingRoomGuest" (
  "bookingRoomId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "guestId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isChild" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "isPrimary" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "registeredAt" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "hotel"."bookingRoomNight" (
  "amount" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "bookingRoomId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "date" date NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "occupancySnapshot" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "bookingRoomNight_amount_nonneg_b0224f56" CHECK ("amount" >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "hotel"."cancellationPolicy" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "hotelId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "hotel"."cancellationRule" (
  "appliesFromDaysBefore" int4 NOT NULL,
  "basis" text DEFAULT 'PERCENT_OF_TOTAL' NOT NULL,
  "feeAmount" numeric(10,2),
  "feePercent" numeric(5,2),
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "policyId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "cancellationRule_basis_check_87bb958e" CHECK ("basis" IN ('PERCENT_OF_TOTAL', 'FIRST_NIGHT', 'FIXED_AMOUNT')),
  CONSTRAINT "cancellationRule_percent_range_3f55e59c" CHECK ("feePercent" IS NULL OR ("feePercent" >= 0 AND "feePercent" <= 100))
)

CREATE TABLE "hotel"."guest" (
  "birthDate" date,
  "city" text,
  "countryCode" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "firstName" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "idDocumentNo" text,
  "idDocumentType" text,
  "lastName" text NOT NULL,
  "nationality" text,
  "notes" text,
  "phone" text,
  "postalCode" text,
  "street" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "hotel"."hotel" (
  "checkInFrom" time,
  "checkOutUntil" time,
  "city" text NOT NULL,
  "countryCode" text DEFAULT 'AT' NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'EUR' NOT NULL,
  "defaultVatRate" numeric(5,2),
  "email" text,
  "fax" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "latitude" numeric(9,6),
  "legalName" text,
  "longitude" numeric(9,6),
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "postalCode" text NOT NULL,
  "receptionFrom" time,
  "receptionUntil" time,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "street" text NOT NULL,
  "timezone" text DEFAULT 'Europe/Vienna' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz,
  "vatId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "hotel"."hotelUser" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "hotelId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "passwordHash" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'employee' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "hotel"."inventory" (
  "allotment" int4 NOT NULL,
  "booked" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "closedToArrival" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "closedToDeparture" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "date" date NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "minStay" int4,
  "roomTypeId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "stopSell" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "inventory_booked_within_allotment_20d5e4c4" CHECK ("booked" >= 0 AND "booked" <= "allotment")
)

CREATE TABLE "hotel"."ratePlan" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "advanceBookingDays" int4,
  "cancellationPolicyId" int4,
  "channelCode" text,
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "discountPercent" numeric(5,2),
  "hotelId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "maxStay" int4,
  "mealPlan" text DEFAULT 'BREAKFAST' NOT NULL,
  "minStay" int4,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ratePlan_mealPlan_check_280a1e27" CHECK ("mealPlan" IN ('ROOM_ONLY', 'BREAKFAST', 'HALF_BOARD', 'FULL_BOARD'))
)

CREATE TABLE "hotel"."ratePrice" (
  "amount" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "date" date NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "occupancy" int4 NOT NULL,
  "ratePlanId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "roomTypeId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ratePrice_amount_nonneg_b0224f56" CHECK ("amount" >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "ratePrice_occupancy_positive_1dbe677e" CHECK ("occupancy" >= 1)
)

CREATE TABLE "hotel"."room" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "floor" int4,
  "hotelId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "number" text NOT NULL,
  "roomTypeId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'CLEAN' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "room_status_check_b5dad1ea" CHECK ("status" IN ('CLEAN', 'DIRTY', 'INSPECTED', 'OUT_OF_SERVICE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "hotel"."roomType" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "bedConfiguration" text,
  "breakfastIncluded" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "channelCode" text,
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "hotelId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "maxAdults" int4,
  "maxChildren" int4,
  "maxOccupancy" int4 NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "pricingMode" text DEFAULT 'PER_ROOM' NOT NULL,
  "shortDescription" text,
  "sizeSqm" int4,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "standardOccupancy" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "roomType_occupancy_sane_f5a2c30b" CHECK ("maxOccupancy" >= "standardOccupancy" AND "standardOccupancy" >= 1),
  CONSTRAINT "roomType_pricingMode_check_9fbdfe81" CHECK ("pricingMode" IN ('PER_ROOM', 'PER_PERSON'))
)

CREATE TABLE "hotel"."roomTypeAmenity" (
  "amenityId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "roomTypeId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "hotel"."roomTypeImage" (
  "alt" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isPrimary" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "roomTypeId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "url" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "hotel"."serviceItem" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "hotelId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "mandatory" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "price" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "unit" text NOT NULL,
  "vatRate" numeric(5,2),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "serviceItem_unit_check_4bc12991" CHECK ("unit" IN ('PER_STAY', 'PER_NIGHT', 'PER_DAY', 'PER_PERSON', 'PER_PERSON_NIGHT'))
)
